newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Hong Kong gazettes new spy law for 1997.
newsitem.headline: Hong Kong gazettes new spy law for 1997.

text.p: The Hong Kong government published a draft anti-espionage bill on Friday to make the law compatible with the colony's future status as a Special Administrative Region of China.
Chinese and British diplomats agreed last week on the need to update the official secrets law to make it useable in Hong Kong beyond next June 30, when the territory returns to Chinese sovereignty.
"Hong Kong, as with any territory, will continue to need legislation to protect official information from July 1. We need local laws to replace the British acts," a government spokesman said.
The bill would go to the Legislative Council next Wednesday, he said.
